NDC-2392 — CRM + Desk Integration missing list: recheck 9 Nov 2026

Draft — not posted. Nothing was sent to Plane. Results table: ndc-2392/results.md. Ledger: ndc-2392/ledger.md.

Comment as it would appear

Recheck on staging, 9 Nov 2026 (tenant NDC-Staging)

Every item was checked again on NDC-Staging (owner account) with the integration connected. Numbers follow this ticket. Result: 4 built, 2 partly built, 11 still missing, 2 not checked. The related bugs NDC-2393..2410 are all Done.

Built now

  • 2. Sync only records in chosen CRM list views ("Sync only records in these CRM views").
  • 3. Contact matching "Primary and secondary email", with the overwrite warning.
  • 4. "Delete the Desk contact / account only if nothing is linked to it".
  • 14. "Contact owner (CRM)" is offered when typing @ in a ticket comment.

Partly built

  • 1. Products sync: sync on/off, CRM module, field mapping and "Also sync each contact's and account's products" are there. Missing: choosing the Desk departments.
  • 5. Initial-sync report: counts and skip reasons are in Failure Log → Skipped. Missing: the email / notice when it finishes.

Still missing

  • 6. CRM Leads are not considered: a Desk contact with a Lead's email still creates a new CRM contact (tested with throwaway records, deleted after).
  • 7. The 12-month window of the first sync is not stated.
  • 9. The CRM pane still shows 8 fixed fields; no way to show other or custom fields.
  • 10. Handshake Mode still shows empty columns (Customers 0, Potentials 0).
  • 11. The CRM Desk Tickets card still has only All / Open / On hold / Closed.
  • 12. No Mutual Users list or "Invite users to Desk".
  • 13. CRM users are not added as Light Agents (none holds "Desk Light Agent"; 5 CRM users have no Desk profile).
  • 15. No reply / comment / update from the CRM notification.
  • 16. No "CRM Contact Type" condition in SLA or assignment rules.
  • 17. Every profile still starts with Full Access; the middle level is still "Custom Access".
  • 18. Voice of the Customer (out of NDC-1669 scope).

Not checked: 8 (needs the integrated owner deactivated) and 19 (cross-app analytics, out of scope).

Evidence (TAVI left, Zoho right): ev-A-sync-settings-vs-zoho.png, ev-B-agent-views-vs-zoho.png, ev-C-crm-side-vs-zoho.png, ev-D-access-users-vs-zoho.png.
